design_intent: A polished, modern, mobile-first communication app interface with a calm premium feel, strong hierarchy, soft surfaces, rounded geometry, and restrained color accents.

primary.description: deep muted green used for active surfaces, emphasis, and selected states

secondary.description: soft mint / pale green used for supportive message bubbles and subtle highlights

accent.description: warm sand / beige used for floating primary action and special emphasis

hierarchy: tiny muted metadata like time and date
characteristics: strong contrast between title and metadata

screen_structure: compact app header with title or contact context
search or action area below header
primary content area in scrollable list form
content_patterns: list rows with avatar, title, subtitle, and metadata
badge indicators for unread or state
sticky floating action button centered near bottom
alignment_rules: keep icons aligned to row edges

structure: optional action icons on the right
rounded lower edge if connected to a colored header block
behavior: can switch between list mode and conversation mode

avatar_system.status_layer: tiny presence dot overlay when active
avatar_system.grouping: horizontal row for recent contacts or participants

structure: active icon highlighted with color and stronger contrast
center floating action button above nav line
behavior: primary action visually separated from navigation

focus_behavior: active element becomes slightly darker or more saturated
selected tab has stronger visual weight
input focus uses soft outline or glow

scale_rules: preserve generous spacing on small screens
ensure touch targets are large enough
safe_area: keep bottom actions above gesture area

for_cursor_context: use rounded cards and pill controls everywhere
use a muted green primary palette with warm neutral backgrounds
keep typography simple and highly legible
make the floating primary action central and prominent
structure lists with avatar + title + subtitle + metadata
use light presence indicators and unread badges
maintain a calm, premium communication-app feel
do_not: do not make layouts dense or cluttered
do not use aggressive outlines or harsh shadows

generated_usage_prompt: Replicate a soft, minimal, premium mobile communication UI with deep muted green header surfaces, warm off-white backgrounds, rounded cards, circular avatars, subtle shadows, thin line icons, a centered floating primary action button, and a clear list-based hierarchy. Preserve strong spacing, calm visual rhythm, and lightweight status indicators while keeping all components touch-friendly and modern.
